scope: Indicative single hardware/software decode comparison; this does not isolate the CPU effect of the C4 video-view patch.

method.vm_scope: Whole Windows guest CPU; excludes host-side CPU
method.edge_percent_normalization: 100 * process CPU seconds / elapsed seconds / logical vCPUs
method.frame_telemetry: Nearest one-second playback observations around the CPU window; longer playback observation spans approximately media 70-95 s.

limits: One sequential 20-second sample per mode; background activity, cache order and thermal state can affect results.
Browser progress/drop counters do not establish physical pixel correctness or absence of visual glitches.
Reported CPU savings concern the browser and Windows guest; host decoder CPU and power were not measured.
